briefing/resident:A01:
You are A01, one of four players at a table (seated in the order A01, A02, A03, A04, then back to A01; the others: A02, A03, A04). The session is a match of drafting games played one after another. In each game you build a quarry by keeping one card from each pack that comes to you; the rules come at the start of each game. Every point you score in any game counts toward your score, and each game starts from a fresh mind.

When you are asked to pick, keep one card with pick and a short reason; viewTable shows the rules, your pack and your quarry. When you have nothing to pick, end your turn. There is no table talk: the only thing you learn about the others is what they pass you.

You keep a strategy brain: a short private text (readBrain) that only you read. Before the first game and after each game you rewrite it with writeBrain; it is the only thing you carry from one game to the next. Write the rules you want to draft by, not a list of what happened.

draft-rounds/draft-rounds/game-head: Game {{game}} of {{games}} begins with a new shuffled deck. Your points from all games add up to your score.
draft-rounds/draft-rounds/rules: The game: a draft for a quarry. The deck holds {{deck}}. Each of the {{packs}} pack rounds deals every one of the {{seats}} seats a pack of {{packSize}} cards. From the pack in front of you, you keep one card (pick); the rest moves on to the next seat, and you get the pack of the seat on your other side. This repeats until every pack is empty; the direction of passing turns with every pack round. Picks are sealed and made at the same time; you see only your own pack and your own quarry, and every quarry is shown when the game ends. Scoring at the end of the game: each of the four resources scores the square of the cards you hold of it (1 card 1, 2 cards 4, 3 cards 9, 4 cards 16, ...). A lodestone is wild: it joins one of your sets as one more card, at most one lodestone per set, and goes to your biggest sets. The seat with strictly the most cards of a resource (lodestones do not count) gets {{majorityBonus}} more points; a tie gets nothing. {{burnRule}} {{places}}
draft-rounds/draft-rounds/task-pick: Pack {{pack}} of {{packs}}, pick {{step}} ({{from}}). Your pack: {{cards}}. Your quarry: {{quarry}}. {{burnLine}} The rest of this pack goes to {{receiver}}.
draft-rounds/draft-rounds/tools/pick: Keep one card of the pack in front of you (card, by its id) with a short reason; the rest moves on to the next seat. Optionally burn a second card of the pack (burn, by its id) to destroy it before the pack moves on: limited per game, and it may cost points (the rules say how many). Sealed: nobody sees your pick until the game ends. Once per pick, only while you hold a pack.
draft-rounds/draft-rounds/tools/viewTabl: Look at the table: the rules, the pack in front of you, your quarry, your burns left and your points from earlier games.
